aliaga.title: Renting a car in Aliağa
aliaga.lead: Aliağa is home to Rentwin's main office. Pick up your car at our office in the Atatürk neighbourhood and start your business or holiday trips around Aliağa right from there.
why: Pick up your car directly from our office on 356 Sk., Atatürk Mah.
Our office is open 7 days a week: weekdays 09:00–21:00, Saturday 09:00–19:00, Sunday 09:00–17:00
Panel vans and double-cab vans alongside cars for work in the industrial zone
Monthly rental options as well as short-term hire
how: Choose your pick-up and drop-off dates and times to list the cars available at the Aliağa office.
Select your car and any extras and place the booking.
Come to our office during opening hours with your ID, licence, and card to collect your car — no deposit required.
paragraphs: Rentwin's Aliağa office is at Atatürk Mah. 356 Sk. No: 16/31, 35800 Aliağa/İzmir. Visitors travelling for business to STAR Refinery, Petkim, and the port facilities can arrange vehicle pick-up with a reservation.

Travel from Aliağa toward Foça, Yeni Foça, and Çandarlı, or request vehicle delivery and meet-and-greet at İzmir Adnan Menderes Airport. Office hours: Monday–Friday 09:00–21:00, Saturday 09:00–19:00, Sunday 09:00–17:00.
aliaga.faqTitle: Renting a car in Aliağa: frequently asked questions

faq.q: Where do I pick up my car in Aliağa?
faq.a: You can collect your car from our office at Atatürk Mah. 356 Sk. No: 16/31, 35800 Aliağa/İzmir during office hours. To have it delivered to an address you choose, contact us.

faq.q: Can I rent a car for work at STAR Refinery, Petkim or the port area?
faq.a: Yes. Visitors travelling for business to these sites can collect their car from our Aliağa office with a reservation. For site work we also offer panel vans and double-cab vans alongside cars.

faq.q: Do you offer monthly car rental in Aliağa?
faq.a: Yes. Alongside short-term hire we offer monthly rental. Our prices exclude VAT; for a current monthly quote call 0507 350 31 35 or message us on WhatsApp.

faq.q: Can you deliver a car from Aliağa to İzmir Adnan Menderes Airport?
faq.a: Yes. We offer vehicle delivery and meet-and-greet at the airport; just mention it when you book.

faq.q: Can I return the car somewhere other than Aliağa?
faq.a: Yes, one-way rental to a different location is possible. A one-way fee is added to the contract; contact us for details.

faq.q: What do I need to rent, and do you take a deposit?
faq.a: You must be at least 25 and have held a driving licence for at least 3 years. A valid driving licence, a Turkish ID card (passport for foreign nationals) and a credit card in the renter's name are enough. We don't take a deposit.

izmir-havalimani.title: Car delivery at Adnan Menderes Airport
izmir-havalimani.lead: Flying into İzmir? Collect your car at İzmir Adnan Menderes Airport. You request airport delivery and meet-and-greet when you book, and after landing you drive straight to Aliağa, central İzmir or your holiday spot.
why: Vehicle delivery and meet-and-greet at the airport are requested when you book
No deposit; an ID, a driving licence and a credit card in the renter's name are enough
Roomy vehicles for groups and trips with lots of luggage
Daily and monthly rental, with every vehicle's price shown up front (excluding VAT)
Drive straight from the airport to Aliağa, Foça, Çandarlı and central İzmir
how: Choose your car and set the pick-up date and time to your flight's landing time.
Select the airport meet-and-greet service when booking and send us your flight details; handover details are confirmed in your booking confirmation.
After landing, collect your car at the airport with your ID, licence and card — no deposit required.
paragraphs: Rentwin's office is in Aliağa, and we deliver cars with meet-and-greet to İzmir Adnan Menderes Airport by reservation. The airport is about 85 km from Aliağa, roughly an hour's drive depending on traffic.

Visitors working at STAR Refinery, Petkim or the Aliağa port, and holidaymakers heading to Foça and Çandarlı, can collect their car at the airport and set off straight away. If you will be working in the area for weeks, a monthly rental is considerably cheaper than the daily rate.
izmir-havalimani.faqTitle: İzmir Airport car rental: frequently asked questions

faq.q: Can I collect a car at İzmir Adnan Menderes Airport?
faq.a: Yes. We offer vehicle delivery and meet-and-greet at the airport. Select airport meet-and-greet when booking and send us your flight details; handover details are confirmed in your booking confirmation.

faq.q: What documents do I need to rent a car at the airport?
faq.a: Bring your valid driving licence, your Turkish ID card (passport for foreign nationals) and a credit card in your own name to the handover at the airport. You need to be at least 25 with a licence held for at least 3 years; no deposit is taken.

faq.q: How long does it take to get from the airport to Aliağa?
faq.a: İzmir Adnan Menderes Airport is about 85 km from Aliağa, roughly an hour's drive depending on traffic.

faq.q: How much does airport car rental cost?
faq.a: Prices depend on the vehicle and exclude VAT. You can compare the current daily and monthly prices of every vehicle on our Car Rental Prices page.

faq.q: Can I return the car somewhere else?
faq.a: Yes. You can collect the car at the airport and return it somewhere else (one-way rental); a one-way fee is then added to the contract. Tell us the drop-off point when you book.

faq.q: Can I rent a car monthly from the airport?
faq.a: Yes. If you will be working in the area for weeks or months, a monthly rental is considerably cheaper than renting the same car at the daily rate. Monthly prices exclude VAT.
